name: ベンフォードの法則
description: Tests pixel 勾配 分布s against Benfords Law - a 統計的 principle that natural data follows a specific first-digit 分布. AI生成の 勾配s deviate from this パターン.
mechanism: 分析します first significant digits in DCT 係数 of 8x8 image blocks. Natural images follow Benfords Law, while AI生成の images deviate from this 統計的 property.
parameters: ブロックサイズ: 8x8, DCT 係数: AC terms, Test: chi2 goodness-of-fit
accuracy: 中 - 65-75%, best as complementary 統計的 test
source: Fu et al. (2007) Generalized Benfords Law for JPEG Coefficients, IEEE TIFS
useCase: Statistical validation of image naturalness through digit 分布

references.title: Fu, D. et al. (2007). Generalized Benford's Law for JPEG Coefficients. IEEE TIFS.
Perez-Gonzalez, F. et al. (2007). Benford's Law in Image Forensics. IEEE ICIP.

strengths:
• Based on well-established mathematical law
• Fast computation with minimal overhead
• Independent of image content type
• Effective complementary 統計的 test
limitations:
• Lower standalone 精度 (65-75%)
• JPEG圧縮 can mask deviations
• Requires sufficient image complexity
• Not effective for very small images
